About Me

I'm an Information Technology graduate with knowledge of software development, web development, database management, networking and data analytics. I've built academic projects using Python, PHP, Angular, Flask, Laravel and MySQL, including an AI-based sales forecasting dashboard and full-stack web applications. Through these projects and my experience as an IT peer tutor, I've developed strong problem solving, analytical thinking, teamwork and communication skills. I'm seeking an entry level IT position where I can apply my technical knowledge, contribute to organisational goals and keep growing professionally.
